answer.approach: Build responsive checkout as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: <form, grid, md:grid-cols-2, <label, focus-visible:.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
